newsitem.title: USA: Hilton Hotels debt offering upped - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Hilton Hotels debt offering upped - dealers.

text.p: Hilton Hotels Corp five-year debt offering was increased in size to $300 million, dealers said on Wednesday.
The deal, which was initially slated to come as a $200 million offering, is seen pricing at a spread of 85 basis points over U.S. Treasuries, they said.

Hilton Hotel's senior unsecured debt is rated Baa1 by Moody's Investors Service Inc and BBB-plus by Standard & Poor's. Both agencies said they may lower Hilton's ratings in light of the company's proposed acquistion of ITT Corp.
The deal, which is expected to price later today, features a coupon reset provision in the event Hilton is downgraded to speculative grade status.
Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities is expected to serve as lead underwriter for the deal.
